parsed.restated: ∃ (r q : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph (Fin q)), 0 < r ∧ H.IsBipartite ∧ IsDegenerate r H ∧ ¬ Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => (SimpleGraph.extremalNumber n H : ℝ)) (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 / (r : ℝ)))
parsed.proof:
unfold DegeneracyConjectureStatement
constructor
· intro h
  by_contra hc
  apply h
  intro r q H hr hb hd
  by_contra hn
  exact hc ⟨r, q, H, hr, hb, hd, hn⟩
· rintro ⟨r, q, H, hr, hb, hd, hn⟩ h
  exact hn (h r q H hr hb hd)
parsed.english: There exist r > 0 and a bipartite r-degenerate graph H on q vertices whose extremal number ex(n, H) is not O(n^(2 - 1/r)) as n → ∞.
parsed.why_clearer: It pushes the negation through the quantifiers, so the claim reads as an explicit counterexample to the degeneracy conjecture instead of a negated ∀-implication.
